events.description: A high volume of 50 failed login attempts from a single IP address indicates an automated brute force or credential stuffing attempt.
events.action: Block IP 192.168.1.100 at the firewall/WAF, trigger password resets for targeted accounts, and verify if any attempts succeeded.

events.description: Internal IP 10.0.0.55 downloaded an unusually large volume of data (15.5 GB) during off-hours (02:05 AM UTC), which may indicate compromised credentials or insider threat activity.
events.action: Isolate IP 10.0.0.55, revoke active user credentials/session tokens associated with the download, and conduct a forensic audit of the accessed data.

events.description: Internal host 172.16.0.200 scanned 1000 ports, indicating potential network discovery or a compromised internal asset performing reconnaissance.
events.action: Isolate host 172.16.0.200, investigate active processes/users on the device, and check network security group logs.

events.description: The service account 'svc-deploy' was granted administrative permissions, creating a high risk of privilege escalation and potential full account compromise if the service account credentials are leaked.
events.action: Immediately revoke administrative access for 'svc-deploy', review audit logs to identify who granted the role, and verify if this privilege escalation was authorized.

raw_event.event: API key used from new location

events.description: An API key was used from an unrecognized IP address and unknown geographic location, indicating potential credential leakage or compromise.
events.action: Revoke the affected API key immediately, review audit logs for unauthorized actions, and enforce IP whitelisting.
